hints.content: The graph of function $f$ is the graph of function $g$ shifted right $9$ units.

To shift the graph of $y=g(x)$ to the right $9$ units, we can replace $x$ with $x-9$ in the equation. 

[[☃ image 1]]



Notice that this is the graph of function $f$, and so $f(x)=g(x-9)$.

options.alt: Two congruent cubic function graphs labeled g of x and g of x minus nine in parentheses on an x y coordinate plane. The x- and y- axes scale by one. The graph g of x has a point at (negative six, negative five). The graph is concave down from the interval negative nine to negative six and is concave up from the interval negative six to negative two. The graph g of x minus nine in parentheses has a point at (three, negative five). The graph is concave down from the interval zero to three and is concave up from the interval three to seven.
